jurisdiction_trap.details: Arbitration mandated in county of user's billing address under AAA rules, but constrained by an aggressive two-stage bellwether batching procedure (80 cases stage 1, 100 cases stage 2) that stalls mass claims indefinitely.

extracted_clauses.violation_type: Forced Arbitration & Mass Filing Neutralization Trap
extracted_clauses.exact_quote: YOU AND VERIZON BOTH AGREE TO RESOLVE DISPUTES ONLY BY ARBITRATION OR IN SMALL CLAIMS COURT... In the first stage, 80 arbitrations will proceed... The remaining arbitrations shall not be filed or deemed filed in arbitration nor shall any arbitration fees be assessed or collected in connection with those claims.
extracted_clauses.plain_english_translation: You give up your right to sue in court or join class actions. If thousands of users are harmed simultaneously, Verizon forces claims into slow-motion batching stages of 80 to 100 cases at a time, effectively blocking your access to justice for years.

extracted_clauses.exact_quote: We may change prices and/or any other term of your Service or this Agreement at any time, but we'll provide notice first... These Terms of Service may be modified by us from time to time without advance notice.
extracted_clauses.plain_english_translation: Verizon can rewrite the contract or raise prices whenever they want. In some cases (like Home Internet Exhibit terms), they explicitly claim the right to change terms with zero advance notice.

extracted_clauses.exact_quote: For example, disallowed damages include those arising out of a Service or device failure, unauthorized access or changes to your account or device, or the use of your account or device by others to authenticate, access or make changes to a third-party account, such as a financial or cryptocurrency account...
extracted_clauses.plain_english_translation: If a hacker SIM-swaps your phone line and steals your bank account or cryptocurrency, Verizon completely disclaims financial responsibility, even if their own employee or system allowed the unauthorized account change.

extracted_clauses.violation_type: Asymmetric Collection Fee & Indemnification Flow Down
extracted_clauses.exact_quote: If you fail to pay on time and we refer your account(s) to a third party for collection, a collection fee will be assessed and will be due at the time of the referral to the third party. The fee will be calculated at the maximum percentage permitted by applicable law, not to exceed 18 percent.
extracted_clauses.plain_english_translation: If you owe money or fall behind, Verizon slaps you with up to an 18% debt collection penalty fee on top of late fees, while capping their own liability to strictly direct basic damages.

strategic_recommendation: AIR-GAP AND MITIGATE. Avoid using Verizon phone numbers for two-factor authentication on critical financial or crypto assets due to explicit SIM-swap/account-takeover liability waivers. Enforce strict off-grid data usage controls and maintain independent documentation of all billing transactions.

target_evasion_tactics: Staggered multi-stage bellwether batching to frustrate mass arbitration administrative fees.
Informal dispute pre-conditions requiring full account detail disclosures before filing.
Incorporation of auxiliary terms across external links to conceal unannounced price hikes and fee recoveries.
